decisions.rationale: No Mega on my side. Lead Gholdengo+Farigiraf: Gholdengo immune to status (WillOWisp), Farigiraf blocks priority (ExtremeSpeed) with ArmorTail, MentalHerb stops Taunt. Turn 1 TrickRoom+Protect. Under TR, Azumarill (Brave 63) destroys with HugePower+LifeOrb; Rotom-Wash provides burns and coverage. Opponent's fast team reversed, no TR counter.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Krookodile+Arcanine for dual Intimidate in game 1. Gengar-Mega has ShadowTag; Aerodactyl carries Tailwind+WideGuard; Dragonite LumBerry+Multiscale+ExtremeSpeed; Arcanine Sitrus+WillOWisp; Hydrapple bulky Regenerator. Plan: TR with Farigiraf+Gholdengo lead, avoid physical attackers early. Azumarill excels under TR.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Gengar + Krookodile lead applies immediate high-speed pressure onto Gholdengo and Farigiraf with Scarf Ground/Dark coverage and Shadow Ball, breaking Sash and threatening early KOs before setups occur. Hydrapple counters Azumarill and Rotom-W under Trick Room using Regenerator bulk, while Dragonite provides Multiscale defensive padding and priority cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets: Gholdengo (Focus Sash, Quiet: Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, Protect), Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Relaxed, Armor Tail: Trick Room, Psychic, Thunder Wave, Protect), Azumarill (Life Orb, Brave, Huge Power: Play Rough, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect), Rotom-W (Sitrus Berry, Bold, Levitate: Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Will-O-Wisp, Protect). Strategy: Mega Gengar + Hydrapple severely restricts their bulky TR core, using Shadow Tag trapping and Hydrapple TR pivot.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Gholdengo Protects to guarantee survival vs double-target; Farigiraf sets Trick Room at -7 priority. Next turn under TR, Farigiraf (72) moves before Gholdengo (93) before Gengar/Krook; I KO Gengar with Psychic/Shadow Ball and pressure Krookodile. 30% Rock Slide flinch on Farigiraf is the only risk, but worth it for strong TR endgame.
decisions.notebook: G1: Opponent led Krook+Arcanine dual Intimidate. Gengar-Mega has ShadowTag; Aerodactyl Tailwind+WideGuard; Dragonite Lum+Multiscale+ESpeed; Arcanine Sitrus+Willo; Hydrapple bulky Regen. My TR core (Farigiraf+Gholdengo) works: Protect+Gholdengo to survive enemy fast leads, then TR flips speed. Opponent has no TR answer except speed control via Tailwind. Keep Azumarill fresh for late-game; Rotom handles Krook/Aero. If I secure TR this turn, game momentum flips.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile (237 Effective Speed) and Mega Gengar (200 Effective Speed) both outspeed Gholdengo (93-122 Speed). Knock Off strips Gholdengo's Focus Sash and delivers heavy damage, allowing Mega Gengar's Shadow Ball to complete the KO before Gholdengo can fire off Shadow Ball or Make It Rain. Eliminating Gholdengo on Turn 1 completely defangs the opponent's offense even if Farigiraf sets Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets: Gholdengo (Focus Sash, Quiet: Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, Protect), Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Relaxed, Armor Tail: Trick Room, Psychic, Thunder Wave, Protect), Azumarill (Life Orb, Brave, Huge Power: Play Rough, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect), Rotom-W (Sitrus Berry, Bold, Levitate: Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Will-O-Wisp, Protect). Strategy: Trap bulky pieces with Mega Gengar; pivot Hydrapple into Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Double-target the Mega to remove it before it can trap with Shadow Tag. Psychic+Shadow Ball likely KO, and even with Protect we keep board control. Gholdengo's Focus Sash avoids single-hit KO from locked Knock Off.
decisions.notebook: G1: Opponent led Krook+Arcanine dual Intimidate. Gengar-Mega has ShadowTag, cannot switch if it stays; Protect breaks chain. Aerodactyl Tailwind/WideGuard; Dragonite Lum+Multiscale+ESpeed; Arcanine Sitrus+Willo; Hydrapple bulky Regen. My TR core wins speed under TR; keep Azu clean for late game. After Gengar-KO, Krook locked or swaps, safe to snowball.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room, both foes outspeed Gengar-Mega and carry STAB super-effective moves (Psychic and Shadow Ball) that threaten an immediate KO. Gengar must Protect to stay safe. Switching Krookodile to Hydrapple brings in a 64 Speed attacker that moves first under Trick Room, resisting Steel and easily absorbing any single-target attacks aimed at that slot.

Gengar must fall to free Gholdengo from Shadow Tag. Both target it: Gholdengo Shadow Ball (76-142%, OHKO chance) + Farigiraf Psychic (55-102%) sum to guaranteed KO. Under Trick Room, Gholdengo moves before Gengar, so if Gengar attacks, it dies first. If Gengar Protects, only Hydrapple chips Gholdengo (49-85% not fatal); then next turn we KO Gengar. Sash protects Gholdengo from any double up.
decisions.notebook: G1 opponent led Krook+Arcanine dual Intimidate, Gengar-Mega ShadowTag traps. Aero Tailwind/WideGuard, Dragonite Lum+Multiscale+ESpeed, Arcanine Sitrus+Willo, Hydrapple Regen. Key: KO Gengar early to allow switches; keep Azu fresh for late under TR. TR has 3 more turns; after Gengar falls, Gholdengo sweeps with Make It Rain.

decisions.rationale: In Trick Room, Gengar-Mega moves last (Speed 200) and cannot safely Protect after using it last turn. Farigiraf's Psychic and Gholdengo's Shadow Ball both threaten super-effective damage into Gengar. Switching Gengar to Krookodile grants complete immunity to Psychic and a resistance to Shadow Ball. Hydrapple moves first in Trick Room (Speed 64) and chunking Gholdengo with Earth Power brings it low/to Sash while taking minimal resisted incoming damage.

Gholdengo at 34% HP is guaranteed KO'd by either Hydrapple Earth Power or Krook Knock Off. Under Trick Room, Hydrapple moves first (slowest), then Farigiraf, then Gholdengo, then Krook last. Protecting Gholdengo wastes both incoming attacks. Switching Farigiraf to Azumarill brings immediate offensive pressure under TR without exposing Gholdengo. Next turn with 1 TR left, pivot to endgame sweep.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads Krook+Hydrapple; Krook Scarf locked if moves but no lock yet (turn3 switch-in). Key: KO Gengar-Mega early to free switches. Azumarill Brave + Life Orb under TR is wincon. Gholdengo Focus Sash unreliably used (was at full when hit to 34%, Sash only triggers from full → 1HP, so Sash intact).

decisions.rationale: In Trick Room, Hydrapple (Speed 64) acts before both Gholdengo and Farigiraf. Earth Power into Gholdengo guarantees a KO if Gholdengo does not Protect or switch out. Krookodile targeting Gholdengo would be redundant since Earth Power goes first; directing Krookodile's super-effective Knock Off into Farigiraf removes its item and applies heavy pressure while Krookodile remains immune to Farigiraf's STAB Psychic.

Gholdengo is guaranteed KO'd by locked Knock Off, so switching to Farigiraf preserves it. Azumarill Ice Punch hits Hydrapple 4x effectively first under TR, potentially removing the Giga Drain threat. Farigiraf can re-set Trick Room next turn.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook locked Knock Off (Scarf), Hydrapple Modest (Earth Power used). Gengar-Mega still in back. Key wincon: Azu + Farigiraf TR control. Farigiraf Mental Herb prevents Taunt. Opp has Aerodactyl (Tailwind/WideGuard/Taunt), Dragonite (Multiscale/Lum), Arcanine (Intimidate/WillOWisp) in back.

decisions.rationale: Azumarill threatens Hydrapple with 4x Ice Punch under TR. Hydrapple Protect completely negates this attack while TR expires. Krookodile moves last in TR, allowing Gholdengo to attack first, but Knock Off will KO Gholdengo (at 34% HP) or deal massive damage to any incoming switch-in like Farigiraf. Positioning post-TR with full-HP Hydrapple and Scarf Krookodile creates a dominant endgame.

Krook (Scarf, 184-237) outspeeds all. Farigiraf at 12% dies to Knock Off before moving, so TR fails. Safest: switch Farigiraf to Rotom-Wash (Ground immune, resists Knock Off), Azu Protect to block Giga Drain. Preserves both mons for next turn pivot.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook Scarf locked Knock Off (revealed), Hydrapple Modest (Earth Power, Giga Drain). Gengar-Mega in back (Timid, fast). Opp has Aerodactyl (Tailwind/WideGuard), Dragonite (Multiscale/Lum), Arcanine (Intimidate/Will-O-Wisp) in back. Key wincon: set TR with Farigiraf (12% HP, Mental Herb used) and sweep with Azu (Brave, LO Ice Punch 4x on Hydrapple/Play Rough 2x on Krook). Need to preserve Farigiraf; Rotom-Wash (Levitate, Sitrus Berry) can spread burns. Future plan: bring Farigiraf back when Krook is gone or weakened to reset TR.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room ended last turn. Krookodile outspeeds Farigiraf (72-100) with Scarf (237 Speed) and Knock Off guarantees the KO on Farigiraf (11% HP) before it can move or set Trick Room again. Hydrapple at 100% HP survives Azumarill's attacks and heavily damages/heals back with Giga Drain.

Rotom Protect blocks Earth Power/Knock Off safely. Azu Ice Punch 4x on Hydrapple chips it hardest (38-66%); if Azu faints to Giga Drain high roll, Rotom+Gholdengo+Farigiraf still threaten. Preserving both is top priority vs fast Krook+Hydrapple.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook Scarf locked Knock Off (revealed), Hydrapple Modest Modest (Earth Power, Giga Drain). Gengar-Mega in back (Timid, fast). Opp has Aerodactyl (Tailwind/WideGuard), Dragonite (Multiscale/Lum), Arcanine (Intimidate/Will-O-Wisp) in back. Key wincon: set TR with Farigiraf (12% HP, Mental Herb used) and sweep with Azu (Brave, LO Ice Punch 4x on Hydrapple/Play Rough 2x on Krook). Need to preserve Farigiraf; Rotom-Wash (Levitate, Sitrus Berry) can spread burns. Future plan: bring Farigiraf back when Krook is gone or weakened to reset TR. Azu Ice Punch on Hydrapple this turn chips it for later KO under TR.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile (Speed 237) outspeeds Rotom-Wash (106-138) and chips it with Knock Off before it acts. Hydrapple's Modest Giga Drain combines with Knock Off to guarantee the KO on 59% Rotom-Wash before it can attack. With Trick Room inactive and opposing backline at low HP (Gholdengo 34%, Farigiraf 11%), removing Rotom-Wash sets up Mega Gengar to easily clean up the remainder of the match.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets: Gholdengo (Focus Sash, Quiet: Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, Protect), Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Relaxed, Armor Tail: Trick Room, Psychic, Thunder Wave, Protect), Azumarill (Brave, Huge Power: Play Rough, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect; Life Orb knocked off), Rotom-W (Bold, Levitate: Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Will-O-Wisp, Protect; Sitrus Berry knocked off). Win condition: Remove Rotom-Wash, then let Mega Gengar outspeed and sweep Azumarill/Gholdengo/Farigiraf.

decisions.rationale: Azu Ice Punch guarantees OHKO on Hydrapple (4x, Life Orb). Rotom burns Krook with Will-O-Wisp, halving its damage and chip. Preserves Rotom to support future Trick Room sweep with Farigiraf. Avoids Protect failure risk due to reduced success rate.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook locked Knock Off (confirmed, Scarf). Hydrapple Modest Modest (Giga Drain, Earth Power, Leftovers, Regenerator). Gengar-Mega in back (fast Timid). Opp has Aerodactyl (Tailwind/WideGuard/Sash), Dragonite (Multiscale/Lum/Adamant), Arcanine (Intimidate/WillO/Sitrus). Wincon: set Trick Room with Farigiraf and sweep with Brave Azu LO. Rotom (Bold Levitate) useful for burns. Need to preserve Farigiraf (12% HP) for TR; bring it back after Krook is weakened/removed.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile cannot KO Rotom-Wash with Knock Off before taking a lethal Hydro Pump. Switching Krookodile to Dragonite safely absorbs Hydro Pump or Will-O-Wisp thanks to Multiscale, 4x Water resistance, and Lum Berry. Hydrapple at 8% HP must Protect against Azumarill's Ice Punch to survive and gain Leftovers recovery. Next turn, Hydrapple can Regenerator-switch to Mega Gengar to lock down the endgame.

Hydrapple's Giga Drain OHKOs either mon. Azumarill likely slower, so Protect blocks both doubles. Gholdengo resists/receives little from Hydrapple and is ExtremeSpeed-immune, preserving momentum. Next turn KO Hydrapple with Ice Punch, then manage Dragonite and backline.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook locked Knock Off (Scarf). Hydrapple Modest (Giga Drain, EP, FB, Protect, Lefties, Regen). Dragonite Adamant Multiscale Lum (used). Back: Gengar-Mega (fast Timid), Krook (Knock locked). Plan: preserve Azu for sweep. Gholdengo Sash intact, good vs Hydrapple. Need eventual Trick Room with Farigiraf but this turn safe. Opp has Arcanine/Aerodactyl unrevealed.

decisions.rationale: Protecting Dragonite blocks potential Will-O-Wisp or Ice Punch while preserving Multiscale. Switching Hydrapple (15% HP) to Mega Gengar brings in full-HP Shadow Tag safely, trapping Rotom-Wash and Azumarill and enabling Mega Gengar (200 Speed) to clean up next turn with Sludge Bomb/Shadow Ball.

Gholdengo at 93 Spe moves after both foes (100-200). Shadow Ball would be sniped before it fires by Gengar then Dragonite. Protect blocks any attack; Ice Punch chips Multiscale Dragonite (46-81.9% without Multiscale) and Azu survives EQ or Sludge Bomb if it hits, preserving our wincon.

Gengar-Mega (200 Speed) outspeeds both foes outside Trick Room. Shadow Ball into Gholdengo (34% HP) guarantees a KO before Gholdengo can move, denying any attack. Dragonite uses Extreme Speed on Azumarill for chip, surviving any hit thanks to Multiscale. Gengar can then finish Azumarill on the following turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team revealed: Gholdengo (Focus Sash, Quiet: Make It Rain, Shadow Ball, Nasty Plot, Protect), Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Relaxed, Armor Tail: Trick Room, Psychic, Thunder Wave, Protect), Azumarill (Brave, Huge Power: Play Rough, Liquidation, Ice Punch, Protect; LO knocked off), Rotom-W (Bold, Levitate: Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Will-O-Wisp, Protect; Sitrus knocked off).

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo cannot Protect (used last turn). Gengar 2x Shadow Ball KOs Gholdengo; Dragonite ESpeed KOs Azumarill. Switching Gholdengo to Rotom (Levitate immune to EQ, neutral to Ghost) and Protecting Azumarill guarantees both survive. Rotom resists Dragonite's other moves. Next turn: Azu Ice Punch KOs Dragonite, Rotom threatens Gengar. Preserves win condition.
decisions.notebook: G2: Krook locked Knock Off (Scarf). Hydrapple Modest (Giga/Earth/Fickle/Protect, Lefties, Regen). Dragonite Adamant Multiscale Lum (used). Gengar-Mega fast Timid, Sludge Bomb threat. Back: Arcanine/Aerodactyl unrevealed. Key: Trick Room far-side with Farigiraf after Dragonite falls. Protect fails if used consecutively. Rotom good pivot (Levitate).

decisions.rationale: At 200 Speed, Gengar-Mega outspeeds Gholdengo (122 max Speed) and guarantees the KO with Shadow Ball against its 34% HP before Gholdengo can attack. Dragonite uses Protect to safely block Azumarill's Ice Punch, preserving its HP. Next turn, Gengar outspeeds Azumarill to clean it up with Sludge Bomb.

Switching Azumarill to Gholdengo (immune to Sludge Bomb, resists Shadow Ball) and burning Gengar with Rotom-Wash denies opponent a double KO. Gengar likely targets now-empty slot, wasting its move. Preserves Azumarill for Trick Room sweep while Gholdengo can set up later.
decisions.notebook: G2: Gengar-Mega fast Timid, Sludge Bomb threat. Dragonite Adamant Multiscale Lum (used). Krook Choice Scarf locked Knock Off. Hydrapple Modest Regenerator Lefties. Back: Arcanine/Aerodactyl unrevealed. Key: preserve Azumarill for Trick Room under Farigiraf. Gholdengo can Nasty Plot vs Gengar. Rotom pivot (Levitate) good. Next: bring Farigiraf, set TR, sweep with Azumarill+Gholdengo.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Tag traps both; Rotom at 4% faints to any attack. Best is to KO Dragonite with Azu's Ice Punch (guaranteed) and burn Gengar with Rotom's WoW, sacrificing Azu to Sludge Bomb. This removes Dragonite and cripples Gengar, letting Gholdengo or Farigiraf take over.
decisions.notebook: G2: Gengar-Mega Timid Shadow Tag traps on entry. Dragonite Adamant Multiscale Lum used. Krook Choice Scarf Jolly locked Knock Off. Hydrapple Modest Regenerator Lefties. Back: Arcanine/Aerodactyl unrevealed. Key: preserve Azumarill for Trick Room under Farigiraf. Gholdengo can Nasty Plot vs Gengar. Rotom pivot (Levitate) good. Next: bring Farigiraf, set TR, sweep with Azumarill+Gholdengo.

decisions.rationale: No valid decision (empty response); defaulted to the first legal option for each slot.

Dragonite's priority Extreme Speed (+2) outspeeds everything and finishes off 3% HP Rotom-Wash before it can move. Mega Gengar (200 Speed) outspeeds Azumarill (63-91 Speed) and guarantees a KO with 2x super-effective Sludge Bomb (min 76.3% damage vs 43% HP). This double KO leaves the opponent with only 34% Gholdengo and 11% Farigiraf against our full Mega Gengar and bench.

Gengar-Mega (165-200 Spe) OHKOs Gholdengo with Shadow Ball. Dragonite (100-132) OHKOs Farigiraf (12% HP) with Dragon Claw. Both Protect is the only action that prevents immediate loss. Attacking fails because Gengar moves first and KOs Gholdengo before it acts. Trick Room cannot activate because Farigiraf dies before it completes (priority -7). Surviving this turn keeps both mons to try next turn.
decisions.notebook: G2: Opponent leads Dragonite Adamant Multiscale Lum (used) + Gengar-Mega Timid Shadow Tag. Back: Krookodile Choice Scarf Jolly (locked Knock Off), Hydrapple Modest Regenerator Lefties; Arcanine/Aerodactyl unrevealed. Key: Gengar outspeeds everything, Gholdengo needs Protect to survive, Farigiraf is too frail to set Trick Room under pressure. Next game plan: lead Azumarill + Farigiraf to set TR fast; preserve Gholdengo as cleaner. Azumarill's Ice Punch threatens Dragonite 4x. Rotom-Wash pivot good vs Ground. Opponent plays conservatively, double-targets unsafe leads.

decisions.rationale: Both Gengar (200 Spe) and Dragonite (132 Spe) naturally outspeed Quiet Gholdengo (max 106) and Relaxed Farigiraf (max 88). Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Extreme Speed priority, but Dragon Claw (132 Spe) easily finishes Farigiraf at 11% HP while Gengar's Shadow Ball (200 Spe) finishes Gholdengo at 34% HP. If either foe Protects, the other is KO'd without dealing damage, guaranteeing a double KO or simple 2v1 win next turn.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: KO Dragonite (guaranteed from 25% with Shadow Ball) while attempting Trick Room. If Gengar Protects or targets Farigiraf, I get TR up and remove Dragonite, creating a winnable endgame. If Gengar targets Gholdengo (most likely), I lose anyway — no other line improves that outcome.

Both Gengar-Mega (200 Speed) and Dragonite (132 Speed) naturally outspeed Gholdengo (max 122) and Farigiraf (max 100). Both opponents used Protect last turn, so consecutive Protect has a high failure rate. Shadow Ball guarantees KO on Gholdengo (34%), and Dragon Claw easily KOs Farigiraf (11%) through Armor Tail since it is non-priority. Targeting both foes locks up the double KO to secure the game.

reflections.summary: The opponent's Mega Gengar outspeed and KOed our key Pokemon, and we failed to set up Trick Room due to pressure from double-targeting. Our team lacked speed control and was vulnerable to Gengar's Shadow Ball, leading to a clean sweep.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, lead with Arcanine (Intimidate, Extreme Speed, Will-O-Wisp) or Aerodactyl (Tailwind, Focus Sash) to gain speed advantage and threaten Gengar. Replace Farigiraf, as it is too frail to set Trick Room under pressure. Consider bringing a faster or bulkier support to disrupt the opponent's tempo.
reflections.notebook: G2: Opponent leads Dragonite Multiscale Lum + Mega Gengar Timid. Back: Krookodile Choice Scarf Jolly (locked Knock Off), Hydrapple Modest Regenerator Lefties. Gengar uses Shadow Ball aggressively, double-targets unsafe leads. Dragonite uses Protect, Extreme Speed, then Dragon Claw. Opponent plays conservatively, doubles on leads. Next game plan: use Arcanine or Aerodactyl for speed control; avoid Farigiraf unless Trick Room is safe. Preserve Gholdengo as late-game cleaner behind speed advantage.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar and Dragonite was ideal against their Trick Room core; Shadow Tag trapped key threats to prevent defensive pivoting while Dragonite's Lum Berry absorbed Rotom-Wash's Will-O-Wisp, enabling late-game double KO pressure.
reflections.adjustment: Against Armor Tail setup leads like Farigiraf, prioritize eliminating Farigiraf immediately rather than attacking secondary slots to unlock Dragonite's Extreme Speed priority earlier.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Trick Room core relies on Mental Herb Farigiraf (Armor Tail) to set TR for Quiet Gholdengo (Focus Sash) and Brave Azumarill (Life Orb). Rotom-Wash runs Bold Sitrus Berry with Will-O-Wisp. Shadow Tag Mega Gengar heavily exploits their passive TR setters by preventing pivots once TR expires.
